interpretation: Every mapped acceptance regression executed successfully in the source-bound validation receipt; fixture and empirical limits remain as stated per case.
The final validation receipt must bind commands, source digests, environment, outcomes and implementation commit. Historical validation is not evidence of passing these corrective cases.
Parameterized node IDs name the test function; the final JUnit records the actual parameter executions.
Partial coverage is recorded explicitly and must not be silently promoted to closed acceptance.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Keep independently qualified completed failures and proofs. Old incomplete positive streams are not feasibility evidence. New completion receipts require exact expected-query coverage and a matching durable stream.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: 10,001 small events, durable incremental journal and measured bounded frame buffering.

Actual kernel producer with 10,002 obligations and a controlled complete adapter; compact final payload and final query-support projection. Separate small native ELK/HermiT fixtures establish native coverage, not large-ontology throughput.
Missing, duplicate, malformed, out-of-order and conflicting events cannot authorize a plan; conflict retains a qualified negative.
Acknowledged failure retained through worker hang, invalid transport and durable search recovery.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Validated SQLite transactions and integrity-checked bounded completion receipts remain reusable. Uncommitted rows are excluded. Conservative stage/persistence reservations, including cleanup grace, are retained after interruption; loading a ledger does not replenish the budget.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Separate injected callback, event-storage and search-ledger stalls; Linux deadline tests allow documented cleanup and scheduler tolerance.
Actual busy callback CPU monitoring plus barrier-controlled sampled RSS threshold while callback blocks; RSS is sampled, not an OS-enforced memory ceiling.
Killed transaction exposes only the committed prefix; corrupted final receipt rejected during supervised replay.
Durable failure, completed incumbent and intact source-exception-backed incumbent survive recovery without a replacement verification charge.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Invalidate affected risk scores/descriptors and graph-dependent neural contexts. Independently qualified feasibility proofs and unchanged primary objective factors need not be discarded solely because risk scheduling inputs changed.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Actual enabled HGT optimizer/risk training and direct HGT readout cover explanation, node and edge truncation; separately frozen HGT descriptor replay checks the same graph-admitted support projection.
Fixed graph/admission projection isolates excluded records; admitted support remains observable and out-of-projection support is rejected.
Raising risk stub proves disabled training bypasses risk readout and loss.
Serialized frozen HGT risk reproduces its score/identity and rejects incompatible admitted supports.
Controlled exact-kernel fixture proves risk ordering leaves unverified higher-utility alternatives in the upper bound.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Rebuild preparation-dependent graph, interaction and risk artifacts when effective limits or retrieval identities change. Reuse semantic/query evidence only under its separate theory/policy/query bindings.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Nondefault node, edge, explanation and text settings resolve explicitly; actual training/acquisition/resume flow is exercised with an instrumented frozen-generator boundary. New v3 execution rejects a supplied graph with missing or mismatched effective-preparation identity; historical v2 behavior stays explicit.
Equivalent resolved graph requests have matching graph/support/pair identities; direct/prepared generation has matching endpoint candidates.
Changing text limit changes preparation identity and rejects exact acquisition/training continuation.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Reweight complete retained semantic query outcomes only when theory, policy and query basis still match; retain unknown masks and actual historical default-weight labels. Mixed-scale trained models require renewed training/selection qualification, not silent exact continuation.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Native OWL teacher and acquisition vectors/masks/scalars agree with distinct nonunit desired/unwanted weights and both outcome types. Actual generated-development evaluation consumes the same target; generation/search return boundaries are controlled.
Independent weighted sum of within-family means matches native semantic target evaluation.
Changing unwanted weight changes target identity; changing desired weight invalidates training/resume dependencies and protocol identity.
Native target reweighting preserves cost; separate objective/teacher fixtures verify subtraction once and neural cost independence.

Actual generated-development labeling and checkpoint criterion use configured nonunit weights; changing desired weight changes target identity, decoded utility and selection criterion. The selected assignment is fixed at a controlled search boundary.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Reuse qualified complete-assignment labels under semantic dependencies; invalidate prior sampler-compliance and derived weighting claims. Preserve actual historical attempt origins; never invent missing origins or inclusion probabilities.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Four explicit strata of 32 total 128 assignment attempts; conflicting prepended uniform fractions and incomplete quartet allocations reject.
Changed effective quota/fraction alters sampler hash; contradictory exploration/proposal/quartet declarations reject.
Repeated complete assignments retain all scheduled origins but one qualified label; restart does not relabel committed assignments.

Unavailable sources, finite-pool exhaustion, unknowns and missing proposal mass keep honest counts. Controlled clock expiry leaves 8 scheduled, 2 attempted and 6 unvisited slots with incomplete quartet explicitly masked.
Same frozen seed/config reproduces attempt order/hash including interrupted collection and duplicate origins.
Higher-order failure stays a plan-risk/support target; feasible pair controls do not become invented pairwise semantic negatives.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Regenerate affected candidate pools and their scores under the corrected generation identity. Deduplication retains family-origin provenance without duplicating candidate alternatives or probability mass.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Disjoint(A,S) fixture protects admissible B in both deterministic representative lookup and zero-draw frozen pool.
Completed family circuit distinguishes a proved empty language when every argument is banned.
Compile timeout and bounded representative search exhaustion remain distinct from logical emptiness and are reported as partial coverage.
Removing the immutable premise allows representatives; editable supports cannot establish immutable contextual bans.
Alias origins share a canonical candidate; impossible mandatory candidate caps reject explicitly; final interventions report removed coverage; probability/gradient equivalence retained.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Regenerate narrowed pools and re-evaluate omission studies. Progressive stages must be nested under unchanged context; changed pool/objective identities reject old bounds. Reuse proof supports only via semantic identities, never obsolete candidate indices.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Omitted-C and narrowed action schedules reject before generation; independently supplied incompatible preserved candidates reject.
Valid nested stage expansion preserves prior canonical candidates and records previous pool identity.
Action, omission, context/filter changes and typed retrieval narrowing are checked before execution.
Final-bundle interventions and missing-symbol controls remain distinct; preservation cannot reinsert removed candidates.
Progressive rounds get distinct input identities; exact-kernel restart rejects changed objectives/schedules and rebuilds conservative scalar bounds.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Exact continuation requires committed phase, optimizer/RNG, data, target and preparation identity. A legacy ambiguous minibatch boundary cannot claim exact continuation: recover a proven boundary or declare a separately selected warm start. Preserve cumulative resource limits.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Three scheduled training cases interrupted after one update retain epoch zero, offset one and exact continuation.
Parameterized durable boundaries cover post-final-update development loss, development selection start and midway selection; incomplete work does not become a completed epoch.

Actual optimizer/dropout resumes to identical model, optimizer, CPU/Python/CUDA RNG state, best selection state, minibatch order/cursors and history; development responses are controlled. Separate native target parity verifies semantic evaluation paths, not empirical selection quality.
Corrective training rejects changed target/preparation; retained v2 regression independently verifies held-out split rejection and changed run identity.
Exhausted cumulative training allowance stays exhausted; loading or increasing a saved total does not create more authorized budget; interrupted wall/CPU/GPU reservations survive replacement.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Retain qualified source consistency/unsatisfiability reports through a source hash resolving immutable input premises and source/import/policy/query/backend bindings. Missing or incompatible legacy proof receipts need explicitly budgeted revalidation; unknown is not an exception.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Native source-proof acquisition interrupted after durable publication; default standalone resume needs no external baseline and obtains a new feasible candidate.
Mutated source, import document, policy, exception-query and qualification identities reject reuse.
Missing/corrupt evidence and inconsistent/unsupported source reports cannot silently exempt a monitored class; explicit legacy revalidation retains real unknown causes.
Shared and standalone native exception projections agree; nested qualified records round-trip without copying unverified scalar checks.
Spent counters, unresolved assignments, conservative bounds and intact qualified incumbent survive exhausted-budget recovery; no new campaign allocation is inferred.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Keep raw durable responses and paid request history. Recompute false-quorum aggregates without duplicate calls; requalify labels/selection/metrics that depended on them. Missing scheduled judgments stay missing. Raw legacy comparisons remain readable but cannot qualify new aggregate targets alone.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Replayed [c,c] supplies one authoritative scheduled observation, so quorum two fails.
Parser revisions of one canonical durable response do not multiply votes.
Distinct genuinely scheduled requests count separately even with identical content and preserve both request/response provenances.
Presentation swaps, disagreement, abstention, invalid outputs and correction lineage respect the frozen schedule; forged/unscheduled observations reject.
Mock request ledger replay performs no additional transport call; aggregation itself performs no live calls.
Serialized training/evaluation inputs reference the authoritative aggregation revision and exact unique observations; overlapping aggregate weights reject.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Historical unused support-head weights remain untrained. Enabled support capability needs corrected labels/loss and renewed training before scientific claims; support-disabled remains a valid arm. Shared encoder updates can change predictions but qualified symbolic supports alone authorize hard cuts.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Native verified three-action conflict yields one higher-order target; verified feasible pair controls do not create pairwise incompatibilities.
Eligible native labels backpropagate into support_head; actual enabled HGT training reports optimized support terms separately.
Unknown target has zero gradient; negative witness controls are independently verified, not inferred merely from removed proof premises.
Disabled support readout is a raising stub, loss terms stay zero, availability counts remain and protocol explicitly disables the claim.
Qualified proof is evaluator-only supervision; same-decision graph hash does not change and future-evidence features reject.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Valid matching immutable compiled structures remain reusable; race protection alone does not alter probabilities. Historical cold timing cannot be reconstructed, and incompatible artifact format/source identity recompiles with new measured receipts.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Deterministic enumeration/stat interleaving deletes an old entry; successful current circuit remains usable.
Two spawned independent identities synchronize publication, evict under a short maintenance lock and retain valid circuits/capacity.
Separate-process immutable artifact checksum corruption rejects cache reuse and recompiles.
Concurrent publication enforces capacity; metadata-scan deadline produces explicit maintenance_timeout; equivalent compiler layouts retain semantic support.

requirements.historical_reuse_and_invalidation: Compatible structural artifacts may remain cached, but new performance comparisons require new measured receipts. Warm-load or in-memory lookup time is never substituted for originating cold compilation; unavailable historical totals stay null.

acceptance_cases.evidence_scope: Cold compile and separate-worker warm load have the same structural identity and distinct measured phase receipts.
Warm receipt retains original cold seconds/limits and current admission seconds/limits.
Unsupported minimization/peak allocated metrics are null; phase CPU/process-lifetime RSS measurements have explicit scopes.
Study plan/results retain exact receipts, charge shared preparation once and reject mismatched cold-required/warm-required policy.

qualification_limits: Local deterministic conformance fixtures do not establish biomedical-scale throughput, memory sufficiency or neural superiority.
The >10,000-obligation fixture exercises the real verification producer using a controlled complete adapter. Native reasoner coverage is demonstrated separately on small OWL fixtures.
CPU and aggregate process-tree RSS are sampled Linux measurements; process cleanup has a bounded grace and explicitly reported incomplete cleanup.
Semantic-fidelity tests use mock transports and durable local records; no live judge calibration or new paid annotation is claimed.
Support supervision capability and gradients are tested. Improvement over whole-plan risk with identical symbolic cuts requires a separately designed future experiment.
No research campaign, production matcher input, supervisor restart, notification or external model call is authorized or performed by this corrective implementation.
historical_artifacts_policy: Keep prior protocols, xr21-validation.json, old result rows, campaign ledgers and raw paid responses immutable; corrected execution uses explicit new identities and dependency-specific reuse.
